key_facts: Maya's brother Daniel died in a car accident in 2021 near the Golden Gate Bridge.
Maya works as an independent private investigator based out of Portland, Oregon.
Detective Carter is Maya's former partner at the Portland Police Department.
Alex is Maya's chief intelligence analyst and suffers from severe chronic asthma.
real_world_claims: The Golden Gate Bridge is located in San Francisco, California.
Portland is the largest city in the state of Oregon.

key_facts: Dr. Robert Vance lost his left hand in an industrial laboratory explosion in 2018.
Dr. Vance was the chief geneticist at Apex Corporation until his termination in November 2020.
Maya is severely allergic to penicillin and carries an epinephrine auto-injector.
Apex Corporation's primary global headquarters is located in Seattle, Washington.
real_world_claims: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928 at St. Mary's Hospital in London.
Seattle is the largest city in the state of Washington.

key_facts: Detective Carter cannot swim due to severe childhood aquaphobia.
Alex's grandfather served as a naval cryptographer in the Pacific theater during World War II.
The secret archive beneath Maya's detective agency requires an 8-digit biometric passkey.
real_world_claims: World War II ended in September 1945.
The human genome contains approximately 3 billion base pairs of DNA.
